chunks.title: Yapı Kredi (Yapı Kredi) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Yapı Kredi is a Turkish Commercial Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Launched 'Yapı Kredi Dönüşüme Tam Destek Programı' (6-category green & digital SME transformation program) at COP31. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: COP31 'Dönüşüme Tam Destek' 6-category green/digital SME loan program + 20% Eco Foreign Trade discount + free carbon footprint & water efficiency platforms. Source verification: https://www.fintechdunyasi.com/cop31de-bankalardan-iklim-finansmani-hamlesi-yeni-finansman-anlasmalari-kobi-programlari-ve-surdurulebilirlik-mesajlari/28721/.

chunks.title: Yapı Kredi Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Yapı Kredi provides the following climate financing instruments: Dönüşüme Tam Destek Green Loan, Eco Foreign Trade Finance Package, Solar/Energy Efficiency Loan, Green Digital Transformation Credit. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 50,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: Yapı Kredi Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Yapı Kredi: SME Green Transition, Renewable Energy, Water Management & Efficiency, Industrial Decarbonization, Digital & Green Twin Transition. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Yapı Kredi Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Yapı Kredi's application form: Turkish company registration (VKN) & credit history; Alignment with 1 of 6 Dönüşüme Tam Destek green/digital categories; Baseline carbon footprint or water-efficiency calculation; Collateral / credit line limit approval. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal expansion; Unpermitted hazardous waste operations. Official application portal: https://www.yapikredi.com.tr/en/sustainability.

chunks.title: Yapı Kredi Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Yapı Kredi uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
